Package com.bilt.pos.session

Class ShopperSession.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.ShopperSession.Builder
Enclosing interface:
ShopperSession
public static final class ShopperSession.Builder extends Object
Builder for a local ShopperSession: a session with the basket, member state, and lifecycle of every shopper session, but no terminal. Nothing is announced anywhere, so start() hands the session out directly.

    • callbackExecutor

      public ShopperSession.Builder callbackExecutor(Executor callbackExecutor)
      Where asynchronously executed operations deliver their handlers — e.g. an Android main-thread executor so handlers may touch UI directly. Applies to execute(); executeSync() and the blocking accessors are unaffected. Overridable per call with callbackOn(executor). Without one, handlers run directly on the session's operation thread and must be fast, non-blocking, and must never synchronously invoke another session operation.

    • onBackgroundError

      public ShopperSession.Builder onBackgroundError(Consumer<SessionError> onBackgroundError)
      Handler for failures of work the session performs on its own behalf, with no result object to report through. A local session has no customer display to refresh, so nothing reports here today; it is accepted so a register configures local and terminal sessions alike. Delivered through the callbackExecutor when one is configured, directly on the failing thread otherwise.

    • start

      public ShopperSession start()
      Validates the configuration and returns the session, ready to ring. There is no device to acknowledge a local session, so unlike TerminalShopperSession.Builder.start() this returns the session itself rather than a lazy SessionResult.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a required field is missing
